title: Expense Agent: Improve expense activity history captions
summary: Expense report activity logs now display user-friendly captions (Activity, Date and Time, Performed By, Details) instead of technical field names, and the FactBox is renamed from Activity Log to History.
key_points: Renamed the FactBox from Activity Log to History for clearer user communication
Replaced technical column headers with descriptive labels (Activity, Date and Time, Performed By, Details)
Field tooltips are now inherited from the activity log table rather than duplicated on the FactBox
Applies to expense reports, posted expense reports, and manager expense report pages
quote: rename the Business Central activity log FactBox to History
